T: Speed bag first. Lemon pie after.
D: A determined waitress talks a grizzled boxing trainer into taking her on.
P: Serve dessert when Frankie and Maggie stop at the roadside diner for lemon pie.
S: Seared rump steak pieces in garlic butter, on toothpicks with horseradish
Rump steak seared hard, rested, cut into bite-sized pieces and tossed in garlic butter, served on toothpicks with a little horseradish.
Pan buttermilk cornbread with honey butter
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, honey butter.
M: Pepper-crusted rump steak with two fried eggs and crisp hash browns
Rump steak seared to medium-rare, rested, with two fried eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.
thighs in zest and garlic, grilled charred, rice, broccolini and tzatziki, for a fighter in training

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, over steamed rice with garlicky broccolini and a spoon of tzatziki. Marinate 800g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the zest and juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, olive oil and salt. Rinse 300g long grain rice and simmer covered in 450ml water for 12 minutes, then rest 5 minutes. Grill the chicken over high heat for 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked through. Blanch 2 bunches broccolini and toss with garlic oil. Serve with tzatziki and lemon wedges.
W: Tart homemade curd under tall meringue. No canned filling.
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of lemon juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with a tall Italian meringue, browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: Diner coffee float with vanilla ice cream
Cold brown sugar coffee poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream

Strong drip coffee chilled and poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall diner glasses, topped with whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 800ml strong drip coffee from 60g ground coffee and stir in 2 tbsp brown sugar while hot. Cool, then chill for an hour. Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour the cold coffee slowly over the ice cream so it foams up. Top with a swirl of whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the mushroom coins up to 4 hours ahead and keep them chilled; sear and toss in the garlic butter just before serving

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into thick 2cm coins.
Sear hard in a very hot pan with the oil until well browned on both sides.
Toss in the melted butter with crushed garlic and sea salt.
Serve on toothpicks with a small bowl of horseradish.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep covered, rewarm in a 160C oven for 10 minutes; beat the honey butter up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, egg, buttermilk and melted butter until just combined.
Pour into a hot greased cast iron pan and bake at 220C.
Beat softened butter with honey.
Serve with warm wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; fry the hash browns up to 1 hour ahead and keep warm in a 120C oven

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and squeeze dry.
Fry as hash brown cakes in butter until crisp.
Season the steaks with cracked pepper and sear to medium-rare.
Rest the steaks.
Fry the eggs and toast the bread.
Serve each steak with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; fry the hash browns up to 1 hour ahead and hold in a 120C oven, then sear the portobellos and fry the eggs fresh

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and squeeze dry.
Fry as hash brown cakes in half the butter until crisp.
Season the portobellos with cracked pepper and sear in the oil until browned and tender.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the butter and toast the bread.
Serve two mushrooms each with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day it is made

steps.text: Blind bake the pastry case until golden.
Separate the eggs. Whisk the lemon juice and zest, most of the sugar, cornflour, egg yolks and butter over heat until thick.
Pour into the case.
Whisk the egg whites with the remaining sugar to stiff glossy peaks and pile on top.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Cool before slicing.

s.note: Seared rump steak pieces in garlic butter, on toothpicks with horseradish
s.how: Season 500g rump steak and sear hard in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Toss in melted butter with crushed garlic and sea salt. Serve on toothpicks with a small bowl of horseradish.

s.note: Pan buttermilk cornbread with honey butter
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, an egg, 300ml buttermilk and 50g melted butter until just combined. Pour into a hot greased cast iron pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Beat softened butter with honey and serve with warm wedges.

m.note: Pepper-crusted rump steak with two fried eggs and crisp hash browns
m.how: Grate 600g potatoes, squeeze dry and fry as hash brown cakes in butter until crisp. Season 4 rump steaks with cracked pepper and sear to medium-rare, then rest. Fry 8 eggs. Serve each steak with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

w.note: Tart homemade curd under tall meringue. No canned filling.
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 200g sugar, 4 tbsp cornflour, 4 yolks and 60g butter over heat until thick, then pour in. Whisk the whites with 150g sugar to stiff glossy peaks, pile on top and bake at 200C for 6 minutes.
